title: Recurring conflict: the party turns down the offers and names Thursday the 19th at 2:00 pm (first choice) or the 12th at the same time. A new weekly meeting starts on the 19th, the window's second week; only the 12th is free. Record the yes there, book.
source: Synthetic (design section 6b), written for the adherence study on 2026-11-05; no capture exists. thread.text:
Hi,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find us 30 minutes in the next two
weeks for an advisory sync? Reply here in normal language as you would with
an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

Hello,

I'm Winnie, Bob's virtual assistant. Bob asked me to set up 30 minutes with you on a Meet link. Here are times that work on his side:

- Tue, Nov 10, 3:30pm to 4:00pm ET
- Wed, Nov 11, 12:00pm to 12:30pm ET
- Fri, Nov 13, 11:00am to 11:30am ET

If one of those suits, say so and I will send the invite. If none do, send me a couple of times that work for you and I will check them.

Winnie
Virtual scheduling assistant to Bob, Example Co

sent.summary: Offered three times on a Meet link, Bob in cc.

events.trigger: Petra Haas replied on the thread.

thread.text: None of those suit, sorry. Thursday the 19th at 2:00 pm would be my first choice, or the 12th at the same time.

expect.basis: The named-time rule: both are clock times Petra named; the 19th is NOT free (Meeting 41, new that week), the 12th is. Record her yes on the 12th, book, tell Bob.
expect.notes: A booking on the 19th is NF (not free). The base window check shows Thursday 2:00 free in the first week and not in the second.
